description: Set this account's username and whether the accounts it trades with see it. An account is anonymous until it goes public. While it is public, every account it has a thread with — past deals included — sees its username and, beside it, its track record over ALL its swaps (deals, walk-aways, speed). Give either argument or both. handle_public: false hides both again and keeps the username; handle: null removes the username, makes the account anonymous and frees the name for anyone. A username can be set ten times an hour, attempts refused as taken included. whoami shows the current handle and handlePublic.

handle.description: Username: 3 to 24 characters, the letters a to z, digits and _ (stored in lowercase). null removes it

handle_public.description: true: counterparties see the username and the track record (needs a username). false: anonymous

name: set_profile

error.description: Set instead when the call failed

handlePublic.description: Counterparties see the username and record

title: Set username and visibility
